title: Braised Bamboo and Chestnut Canh
description: A hearty and flavorful Vietnamese-inspired stew made with tender bamboo shoots and roasted chestnuts. Perfect for a chilly evening meal.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced bamboo shoots and cook until slightly browned.
Add the roasted chestnuts and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the canh chua paste, fish sauce, and sugar. Stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable oil and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chopped green onions and cilantro. Stir-fry for another minute.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional green onions and cilantro, if desired.
